extracted.name: Alfredo pasta
instruction_lines: In saucepan over medium heat melt the butter and garlic until you smell garlic fragrance
Add 2 tbs flour stir with fork
Add 1/4 cup milk whisk till it’s warm
Add the cream cheese till it gets smooth and creamy
Turn off heat Add the Macaroni in the mix and add the seasoning and parmesan cheese and stir
